# 10. Goal Preference {.unnumbered}

*What is your goal orientation?*

## The Mindset(s) {.unnumbered}

- **Evaluative ↔ Developmental**: whether assessment exists to judge the work or to improve it.
  - *Survey item:* items pending.
- **Process focus ↔ Outcome focus**: whether you steer by how the work is done or by what
  it produces.
  - *Survey item:* items pending.
- **Learning ↔ Performance**: whether you pursue goals to grow or to demonstrate ability.
  - *Survey item:* items pending.

**Polarity:** Evaluative ↔ Developmental; Process ↔ Outcome.

**Measure:** Teachers' Conceptions of Assessment (Brown, 2006); Outcome and Process Scale
(2017); Work Domain Goal Orientation (VandeWalle, 1997).

::: {.callout-note}
## Measure pending
All three instruments are copyrighted and have not yet been sourced. The OPS citation also
needs to be confirmed.
:::

## Reflect and Plan

::: {.callout-warning}
## Journal
- **Score:** How does reflecting on your score help you think about who you are as a mentor?
- **Behavior:** To be the best mentor you can be, what is one new thing you will try to do this week for mentees and/or your team?

## During Class
Make note of whether you steer your team by the process of the work or by its outcomes.
